gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
They've just moved ___ to their new flat.
gaps.explanation: move in = start living in a new home.

gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: It's hard to keep ___ with the latest slang.
gaps.explanation: keep up with = stay level with somebody/something changing.

gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
The fire blew ___ the gas cylinder exploded.
gaps.explanation: blow up = explode, or make something explode.
